description: This file contains a parser implementation for C++-style header files, including classes for representing class and method data, and functions to parse class structures, namespaces, and methods. It also includes a printer for visualizing the parsed class hierarchy.

classes.name: ScopeType
classes.description: Enumeration for different scope types: CLASS, NAMESPACE, OTHER.

classes.name: MethodData
classes.description: Represents method information including name, return type, parameters, and const qualifier.

classes.name: ClassData
classes.description: Represents class or interface data, including name, namespace, tags, methods, and child classes.

classes.name: InterfaceTree
classes.description: Data structure for storing parsed class/interface hierarchy, with methods to add classes, methods, and manage scope.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Main parser class that reads a file and extracts class, namespace, and method information.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: Utility class for printing the class hierarchy in a readable format.

methods.name: extractMethodData
methods.description: Extracts method details from a line of code using regex.
